concept_options.title: A Clear Strip for Suitable Gaps
concept_options.hook: Cold drafts around a door gap?
concept_options.visual_approach: A 15-second source-led reveal using existing door-gap, package, strip-detail, and application footage.
concept_options.target_audience: Homeowners and renters considering low-profile weather stripping for suitable small gaps.
key_points: Three rolls; approximately 49 feet total, according to supplied product facts.
Measure first; fit and surface compatibility matter.
concept_options.core_message: A targeted weather-stripping option for suitable small gaps, not a fix for every opening.
concept_options.cta: Measure first and check the surface compatibility.
concept_options.why_this_works: Introduces the product and gives a practical buyer-fit qualification without promising performance.

concept_options.title: How the Strip Is Intended to Be Applied
concept_options.visual_approach: Use existing door-edge and strip footage to illustrate measuring, preparing, positioning, and checking fit.
concept_options.target_audience: DIY-oriented homeowners and renters considering adhesive-backed weather stripping.
key_points: Check the gap and surface before applying.
Measure and cut the strip to fit.
Check door movement and latch clearance.
concept_options.core_message: Preparation and fit matter more than simply sticking the strip in place.
concept_options.cta: Follow the product instructions and check the fit before applying.
concept_options.why_this_works: A concise installation-oriented alternative, without claiming personal testing.

concept_options.title: Is This Weather Stripping Right for Your Gap?
concept_options.hook: Not every gap is a match.
concept_options.visual_approach: Use supplied package and application clips with simple limitation-led overlays.
concept_options.target_audience: Buyers comparing weather-stripping options and trying to avoid a poor fit.
key_points: Adhesive compatibility and surface preparation matter.
Not a repair for damaged frames or large irregular gaps.
concept_options.core_message: The right buyer has a suitable gap and compatible surface.
concept_options.cta: Measure the gap and check the surface before choosing.
concept_options.why_this_works: A buyer-focused qualification angle that emphasizes fit and limitations.
